name: laravel-monocle-assets

scripts.build: esbuild resources/js/dashboard.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/*! Monocle dashboard. Bundles Alpine.js (c) Caleb Porzio and contributors, MIT license. */" --outfile=resources/dist/monocle.js && esbuild resources/css/dashboard.css --bundle --minify --outfile=resources/dist/monocle.css

//overrides: VitePress 1.6 pins vite ^5, where the fs.deny bypass and the esbuild dev-server advisories are unpatched.
Both are dev-server issues and none of this ships - package.json is export-ignored - but the lockfile is
what Dependabot reads. Drop these once VitePress 2 is stable and depends on vite 6 itself.
